title: Constraint: Exactly Five Consecutive Bits
constraints: `v` (32 bits) has exactly 5 ones, and they form **one** contiguous run. All 28 possible positions should show up (the testbench needs ≥ 24 of them in 200 calls).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Formulation 2: a helper shift amount `rand int s; s inside {[0:27]}; v == 32'h1F << s;`.
Watch for 5 ones as two runs (3 + 2): the second rule must exclude them.
